# The Shakti Collective

> The Shakti Collective is a culture-first artist development ecosystem for singers, musicians, producers, storytellers, and conscious creative communities. We build systems for learning, collaboration, storytelling, films, and sustainable creative careers.

The Shakti Collective (TSC) is a culture-forward artist ecosystem company founded and curated by Rohith Sobti. TSC works across music education (TSC Academy), artist partnerships (TSC Artists / Artist Path), film mounting and IP (TSC Films), brand collaborations, and editorial resources for independent artists.

Canonical site: https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app  
Contact: Artist@theshakticollective.in  
Full corpus for LLMs: [llms-full.txt](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/llms-full.txt)

## Core pages

- [Home](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/): Culture-first ecosystem overview — mentorship, collaboration, learning, and go-to-market for artists
- [About](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/about): Who TSC is, why it exists, verticals, philosophy, and founder Rohith Sobti
- [About (Markdown)](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/about.md): Plain-text About page for AI parsers (preferred over Wix HTML)
- [Work](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/work): Platforms, partnerships, and cultural initiatives (brand IPs, artist programs, films)
- [TSC Artists](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/artists): Independent artist partnerships — development, audiences, live, PR, career support
- [Artist Path](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/artist-path): Selective artist accelerator and growth diagnostic for emerging talent
- [Films](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/films): Film mounting, audience development, partnerships, and long-term IP growth
- [TSC Academy](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/academy): Mentorship-led music learning from composers, classical masters, and producers
- [Learn With TSC](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/learn-with-tsc): Mentorship-led music education and craft frameworks
- [Resources](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/resources): Guides and tools for release strategy, craft, and sustainable artist careers

## Academy courses

- [Roots of Hindustani Classical](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/roots-of-hindustani-classical): Mentored by Pandit Prasad Khaparde — raag, sur, voice culture, riyaaz
- [The HeART of Composition](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/the-heart-of-composition): Mentored by Sandesh Shandilya — emotional architecture of composition and songwriting

- [All Courses Bundle](https://wix-site-clone-psi.vercel.app/course-bundle): All three TSC Academy courses bundled from ₹12,000 to ₹9,999
